biography.value: A tyrant of living shadow, half construct and half undead, Umbrathor commands darkness itself. He fades from sight in dim light, tears the warmth from the living with bolts of night, and bends lesser shadows to his will. Slaying him may yield his Cloak of Shadows and Amulet of the Night.

description.value: Umbrathor can manipulate shadows to create illusions or hide himself. While in dim light or darkness, he can take the Hide action as a bonus action and can become invisible at will.

activation.condition: While in dim light or darkness.

description.value: Ranged Spell Attack: +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (8d8) necrotic damage, and the target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest.
description.chat: A bolt of devouring night streaks from Umbrathor's talons!

description.value: The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, until it finishes a long rest.

effects.name: Dark Bolt: Max HP Reduced
effects.description: Your hit point maximum is reduced by the necrotic damage dealt by Umbrathor's Dark Bolt. Apply the reduction manually with the Modify button, then remove this effect at the end of a long rest. This is a placeholder effect and does not track the exact amount.

description.value: Each creature of Umbrathor's choice within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of him for 1 minute. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
description.chat: Umbrathor's presence crushes the courage from the room!

effects.name: Terrifying Presence
effects.description:
You are &reference[frightened apply=false] of Umbrathor for 1 minute.

You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success.

description.value: Once per encounter, Umbrathor can summon [[/r 1d4]] shadow minions (use the Shadow stat block) to fight alongside him. They last for 1 minute or until reduced to 0 hit points.
[[/r 1d4]] @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.QGcQYZbVl4bWzi4E]{shadows} rise from the gloom and fight for Umbrathor for 1 minute.
As a bonus action, Umbrathor can teleport from one shadow to another within 60 feet.
description.chat: Umbrathor melts into one shadow and flows out of another!

description.value: Cantrip. Umbrathor regains hit points equal to [[/r 1d8 + 6]] (1d8 + his Charisma modifier). If he is in dim light or darkness, he regains an additional [[/r 1d4]] hit points.
description.chat: Shadows seep into Umbrathor, knitting his wounds shut.

description.value: [[lookup @resources.legact.label]]

Legendary Action (1). Umbrathor targets one creature within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be &reference[restrained apply=false] by shadowy tendrils until the end of its next turn.

effects.name: Shadow Grasp: Restrained
effects.description: You are &reference[restrained apply=false] by shadowy tendrils until the end of your next turn.

description.value: Legendary Action (1). Umbrathor regains hit points equal to [[/r 1d8]] if he is in dim light or darkness.
description.chat: Umbrathor draws strength from the surrounding gloom.

activation.condition: If Umbrathor is in dim light or darkness.

description.value: Legendary Action (2). Umbrathor projects horrifying visions into the minds of his enemies. One creature within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or take 36 (8d8) psychic damage and be stunned until the end of its next turn.
description.chat: Your mind is flooded with visions of endless dark!

effects.name: Nightmare Visions: Stunned
effects.description: You are &reference[stunned apply=false] until the end of your next turn.

description.value:
Wondrous item (requires attunement)

This tattered cloak drinks the light around it. While wearing it in dim light or darkness, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

effects.name: Cloak of Shadows
effects.description: While in dim light or darkness, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. (Toggle this effect when the condition applies.)

description.value:
Wondrous item (requires attunement)

While wearing this amulet of black crystal, when you deal necrotic damage to a creature, you deal an extra [[/r 1d6]] necrotic damage to that target.

effects.name: Amulet of the Night
effects.description: While worn, your attacks that deal necrotic damage deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage. (Activate when equipped.)

description.value: Shadow floods a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on a point Umbrathor can see within 120 feet, lightly obscuring the area until initiative count 20 on the next round. While the area is obscured, Umbrathor's shadow attacks can originate from any point within it.

Shadowy tendrils lash at one creature Umbrathor can see within 120 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 4d8 necrotic damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage dies and rises as a Shadow under Umbrathor's control at the start of his next turn.

A wave of grave-chill rolls out from Umbrathor. Each creature within 30 feet of him must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 2d10 cold damage on a failure, or half damage on success. A creature that fails is also slowed by the cold (its speed is halved) until initiative count 20 on the next round.

Living shadow erupts beneath one creature Umbrathor can see within 90 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or take 3d8 necrotic damage and be &reference[restrained apply=false] by shadowy tendrils until initiative count 20 on the next round. While restrained this way, the target takes 1d6 necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns.
Umbrathor melds into the shadows and teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see, reemerging from the darkness.

While Umbrathor is in his lair, he can invoke the ambient power of the Shadow Cavern to take lair actions. On initiative count 20 (losing all initiative ties), he takes one lair action:

  • He casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.S7VbUetIfVT7B6Eq]{Darkness} without expending a spell slot, targeting a point he can see within 60 feet.
  • Shadowy tendrils lash at one creature he can see within 120 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 4d8 necrotic damage.
  • Umbrathor melds into the shadows and teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

effects.name: Lair Shadow Grasp: Restrained
effects.description: Restrained by shadowy tendrils until initiative count 20 on the next round. Takes 1d6 necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns.

description.value:
The region containing Umbrathor's lair is warped by his abyssal magic, creating the following effects:

Claustrophobic Dark. Magical darkness fills 120 feet of the lair. Nonmagical light is dimmed to dim light, and creatures with darkvision cannot see through it.

Whispers in the Void. Any creature that starts its turn in the lair while having half its hit points or fewer hears murmuring shadows and must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be &reference[frightened apply=false] until the start of its next turn.

Umbral Murk. Pools of shadow shift unnaturally; areas of dim light within the lair are lightly obscured, and Umbrathor can emerge from any such area when using Shadow Step.

If Umbrathor dies, these effects fade over 1d10 days.
